title_en: The Harry Potter 11-Film 4K Blu-ray Collection Drops to a New Low Price for Back to Hogwarts Celebrations
body_en:
The best Labor Day sales have kicked off for 2026 at exactly the same time as Back to Hogwarts celebrations . That means right now is actually a pretty good time to find deals on Harry Potter gifts . For those who fell in love with the movies, one of the best deals going on right is on the new 11-film collection.
This massive 4K movie collection was released back in May of this year for $129.99 and this is the first time we've seen a significant discount on the set. It includes all eight of the Harry Potter movies as well as the three Fantastic Beasts films. This deal is available across multiple retailers, including Amazon, Best Buy, and Gruv.
This Harry Potter movie collection is pretty straightforward. You get 11 4K UHD discs (one for each movie) all wrapped up in a big box. It's not nearly as fancy as the steelbook library case that sold out almost instantly last month, but it will certainly get the job done if you simply want to own all of the films in 4K.
It's worth noting that this collection does not include any special features whatsoever. As one Redditor who bought the set pointed out, the bundle just includes the discs and none of the bonus content. This is true of all Harry Potter collections that have gotten the 4K treatment, however, and you can only find the extra goodies on the Blu-rays.
If you're a fan of Harry Potter and want to watch the films in the highest definition possible, the 4K discs are the way to go. You can stream all of these movies in 4K with a premium HBO Max subscription , but streaming just doesn't offer the same quality as 4K Blu-ray .
Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics -- from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .
